description: Find Japan restaurants and bars, then keep a factual trip shortlist.

tools.name: catalogs_home
tools.description: Public prefecture and cuisine links; use anchors as authoritative catalog entries. Returns the SourceHTML.

tools.name: catalogs_suggest
tools.description: Public mixed-type suggestions. Requires ordinary AJAX Accept,X-Requested-With and Referer headers (source adapter contract). Required: keyword. Returns array of Suggestion.

tools.name: restaurants_get
tools.description: Fetch public restaurant details as HTML containing tables and JSON-LD. Required: prefecture, area1, area2, id. Returns the SourceHTML.

tools.name: restaurants_search
tools.description: Search the observed public English HTML source; typed card extraction must be implemented in the source adapter. Optional: source-sort (default: rt), prefecture, prefecture-code (plus 10 more). Returns the SourceHTML.

params.name: prefecture-code
params.description: Prefecture numeric code from More filters

params.name: area1
params.description: First area code or municipality code from suggestion

params.name: location-id
params.description: Observed selected location name or ID

params.name: category-family
params.description: Source category family; BC is Bar

params.name: keyword
params.description: Free text; effective geography must be checked

novel_features.name: Offline factual comparison
novel_features.description: Compare saved restaurants, meal budgets and personal notes without network requests.

novel_features.name: Bounded refresh with fact changes
novel_features.description: Update selected saved restaurants and see changed facts while keeping personal notes.

novel_features.name: Trip notebook with personal notes
novel_features.description: Keep fetched restaurants and personal notes in a named trip list that can be resumed offline.

novel_features.name: Saved alternatives with explicit constraints
novel_features.description: Find saved substitutes matching a candidate's verified area, category and optional meal budget.

novel_features.name: Missing-evidence and freshness audit
novel_features.description: See which saved candidates have unfetched, unknown or old facts before requesting more details.
